name: Tenant Turner
positioning: Leasing automation for US property managers: syndicate the listing, pre-qualify the lead, let the prospect book a showing and open the door themselves.
description: Tenant Turner automates the leasing cycle between a vacant unit and a signed lease. It imports listings from the property management system and pushes them to more than twenty listing sites, applies the manager's own pre-qualification criteria before a prospect can book, and offers either in-person showings or self-showings through electronic lockboxes and smart locks. Prospects self-schedule around the clock; reminders, cancellation of unconfirmed appointments, post-showing feedback collection and application dispatch run automatically. The Ultra plan adds a live answering service for leasing calls. Reporting covers lead flow, showing activity, lockbox use and owner-facing performance.
real_estate_use: Vacancy costs a US property manager more than almost anything else in the operating budget, and the bottleneck is rarely demand — it is the coordination. Someone has to answer the phone, decide whether the caller meets the income and pet rules, agree a time, and physically be at the property. Tenant Turner removes all four steps: the pre-qualification questions gate the calendar, the prospect books at any hour, and a lockbox or smart lock grants access without a staff member driving across town. The manager sees which listings produce leads and which produce no-shows, and hands the owner a report that explains a slow lease-up with numbers. It sits alongside the property management system rather than replacing it, which is why it shows up in the integration directories of the major platforms.
features: Listing import from the property management system and syndication to 20+ listing sites
Customisable lead pre-qualification gating access to the showing calendar
Self-showings via electronic lockboxes and smart locks, or in-person showings
24/7 prospect self-scheduling with reminders and automatic cancellation of unconfirmed appointments
Post-showing feedback collection and automatic application dispatch
Leasing analytics and owner reports covering leads, showings and lockbox use

use_cases.job: Fill a vacant single-family unit without a staff member attending every showing
Screen out unqualified enquiries before they reach the calendar and see why a listing is not converting

capabilities: AI virtual leasing agent marketed for handling prospect enquiries
